The current is a trace over the orbital indices of the lead, with $G$, $\Gamma_L$ and $\Gamma_R$
the retarded propagator and the coupling matrices. Using cyclicity of the trace,
\begin{equation}
\mathrm{Tr}\left(\Gamma_L G \Gamma_R G\right) = \mathrm{Tr}\left(\Gamma_R \Gamma_L G G\right) .
\label{eq:tr}
\end{equation}
